## TensorFlow Playground

TensorFlow Playground uses URL hash fragments (starting with `#` instead of `?`) to store the configuration state. This allows you to share exact setups without needing to reload the webpage.

Here are the complete URLs that directly load the final configurations for each of the five activities:

**1. Discover Why We Need Non-Linearity**
*(Circle dataset, 1 hidden layer with 3 neurons, ReLU activation, $X_1$ and $X_2$ features)*

```text
https://playground.tensorflow.org/#activation=relu&batchSize=10&dataset=circle&regDataset=reg-plane&learningRate=0.03&regularizationRate=0&noise=0&networkShape=3&seed=0.123&showTestData=false&discretize=false&percTrainData=50&x=true&y=true&xTimesY=false&xSquared=false&ySquared=false&cosX=false&sinX=false&cosY=false&sinY=false&collectStats=false&problem=classification&initZero=false&hideText=false

```

**2. Feature Engineering vs. Deep Networks**
*(Circle dataset, 0 hidden layers, Linear activation, only $X_1^2$ and $X_2^2$ features)*

```text
https://playground.tensorflow.org/#activation=linear&batchSize=10&dataset=circle&regDataset=reg-plane&learningRate=0.03&regularizationRate=0&noise=0&networkShape=&seed=0.123&showTestData=false&discretize=false&percTrainData=50&x=false&y=false&xTimesY=false&xSquared=true&ySquared=true&cosX=false&sinX=false&cosY=false&sinY=false&collectStats=false&problem=classification&initZero=false&hideText=false

```

**3. The "XOR" Problem**
*(XOR dataset, 1 hidden layer with 4 neurons, Tanh or ReLU activation, $X_1$ and $X_2$ features)*

```text
https://playground.tensorflow.org/#activation=tanh&batchSize=10&dataset=xor&regDataset=reg-plane&learningRate=0.03&regularizationRate=0&noise=0&networkShape=4&seed=0.123&showTestData=false&discretize=false&percTrainData=50&x=true&y=true&xTimesY=false&xSquared=false&ySquared=false&cosX=false&sinX=false&cosY=false&sinY=false&collectStats=false&problem=classification&initZero=false&hideText=false

```

**4. Conquer the "Spiral"**
*(Spiral dataset, 3 hidden layers with 8 neurons each, ReLU activation, learning rate 0.03)*

```text
https://playground.tensorflow.org/#activation=relu&batchSize=10&dataset=spiral&regDataset=reg-plane&learningRate=0.03&regularizationRate=0&noise=0&networkShape=8,8,8&seed=0.123&showTestData=false&discretize=false&percTrainData=50&x=true&y=true&xTimesY=false&xSquared=false&ySquared=false&cosX=false&sinX=false&cosY=false&sinY=false&collectStats=false&problem=classification&initZero=false&hideText=false

```

**5. Overfitting and Regularization**
*(Circle dataset with 30% noise, 3 hidden layers with 8 neurons each, ReLU activation, L2 Regularization at 0.03)*

```text
https://playground.tensorflow.org/#activation=relu&regularization=L2&batchSize=10&dataset=circle&regDataset=reg-plane&learningRate=0.03&regularizationRate=0.03&noise=30&networkShape=8,8,8&seed=0.123&showTestData=false&discretize=false&percTrainData=50&x=true&y=true&xTimesY=false&xSquared=false&ySquared=false&cosX=false&sinX=false&cosY=false&sinY=false&collectStats=false&problem=classification&initZero=false&hideText=false

```

*(Note: Simply copy and paste these into your browser. Once loaded, click the **Play** button in the top left to watch the network train from that exact state.)*
